_why.R15-no-chain: guide/index.md lists what the application does not do, and the three-item chain is the claim.
_why.R27-aphorism: Counted closers that are not aphorisms. Masking a markdown link leaves 'md).' or 'svg)' as the whole of a sentence, and a one-token sentence reads to rule 27 as a short generalisation. install.md ends four paragraphs on a cross-reference and architecture.md counts two image alt texts among its paragraphs; instrumenting the linter showed every counted close on those two pages is one of those. The snippets are the tails.
